about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Roomali Roti Handkerchief Flatbread
recipes.summary: Paper-thin, soft flatbreads stretched wide and cooked on an upturned pan, folded like a handkerchief.

items: 2 tbsp plain flour, extra for dusting

steps: Mix the flours, salt, oil and water to a soft dough and knead for 8 minutes, until smooth and stretchy.
Cover and rest for 30 minutes, then divide into 8 balls.
Roll each ball as thin as you can and stretch gently over your knuckles until it is almost see-through.
Heat a wok or heavy pan upturned over high heat until very hot.
Cook each roti for 30 seconds each side, until pale with light brown freckles, then fold in quarters.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Keep the cooked rotis wrapped in a clean cloth so they stay soft. Best eaten the same day.

recipes.title: Palak Thepla Spinach Flatbread
recipes.summary: Soft Gujarati flatbreads flecked with spinach and spice, a travel-friendly breakfast with yoghurt or pickle.
steps: Mix the flour, spinach, yoghurt, 1 tablespoon of oil, spices and salt in a bowl.
Add the water and knead for 5 minutes into a soft, slightly sticky dough.
Rest for 15 minutes, then divide into 8 balls and roll each into a thin 14cm round.
Cook on a hot dry frying pan for 1 minute, until blistered, then flip and brush with oil.
Cook until golden brown spots appear on both sides, about 1 minute more.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Keeps 2 days wrapped; reheat in a dry pan.

recipes.title: Bhatura Puffed Fried Bread
recipes.summary: Puffed, tender fried breads, served with chana masala for a classic north Indian brunch.
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then rub in 2 tablespoons of oil.
Add the yoghurt and enough water to make a soft dough, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Cover and rest for 1 hour, then divide into 6 balls and roll each into a 15cm oval.
Heat the frying oil to 180C and slide in one bread at a time.
Press gently so it puffs, then fry about 40 seconds each side, until golden, and drain on paper towel.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Fry in a deep, stable pot, keep children away and never leave hot oil unattended. Serve straight away while puffed.

recipes.title: Afghan Bolani Leek and Potato Flatbread
recipes.summary: Thin pan-fried flatbread stuffed with spiced potato and leek, served with yoghurt and mint.
steps: Mix the flour, salt and water to a firm dough, knead for 5 minutes and rest for 30 minutes.
Cook the leek in 1 tablespoon of oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then mix with the potato, coriander, chilli and salt.
Divide the dough into 6 balls, roll thin and spread the filling over half of each round.
Fold over to a half moon and press the edges closed.
Cook in a frying pan with a little oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden and crisp, then serve with yoghurt.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Best eaten fresh.

recipes.title: Piadina Romagnola Flatbread
recipes.summary: A soft, thin Italian flatbread cooked on a hot pan and folded around cheese and greens.
steps: Mix the flour, salt and baking powder, then stir in the oil and enough milk to form a soft dough.
Knead for 3 minutes, rest for 30 minutes and divide into 6 balls.
Roll each into a thin 20cm round and prick all over with a fork.
Cook in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes each side, until golden with brown spots.
Fill with rocket, mozzarella and tomato and fold in half to serve.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Contains dairy and gluten.

recipes.title: Focaccia Barese with Potato and Tomato
recipes.summary: A soft, olive-oily Pugliese focaccia topped with cherry tomatoes and olives, made with mashed potato for tenderness.
steps: Mix the yeast, sugar and water and stand for 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine with the flour, potato, salt and 1 tablespoon of oil and knead for 8 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and rise for 1 hour, then press into an oiled 25 by 35cm tin.
Dimple the dough with your fingers, scatter with the tomato, olives and oregano, drizzle with the remaining oil and rise for 30 minutes.
Bake at 220C for 30 minutes, until deep golden.
notes: Rising time is not included in prep. Keeps 2 days; refresh in a hot oven.

recipes.title: Norwegian Lefse Potato Flatbread
recipes.summary: Tender potato flatbreads rolled thin and griddled, spread with butter and sugar or served with smoked salmon.
steps: Mash the potato until completely smooth with the butter, cream and salt, then cool completely.
Work in the flour to form a soft dough and divide into 8 pieces.
Roll each very thin on a floured surface into a 20cm round.
Cook on a dry hot pan for 1 minute each side, until pale with light brown spots.
Cool under a damp cloth, spread with butter and sugar and fold.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge wrapped in a damp cloth, and freezes well.

recipes.title: Chinese Shaobing Sesame Flatbread
recipes.summary: Flaky, layered sesame breads baked until crisp, a northern Chinese breakfast beside soy milk.
steps: Mix the flour, salt, sugar, yeast and water and knead for 8 minutes until smooth, then rise for 1 hour.
Mix 2 tablespoons of oil with the extra flour to make a paste.
Roll the dough thin, spread with the paste, roll up like a log and cut into 8 pieces.
Flatten each into a 8cm disc, brush with water and press into the sesame seeds.
Bake at 220C for 18 minutes, until puffed and golden.
notes: Rising time is not included in prep. Best eaten warm.

recipes.title: Indonesian Roti Cane Griddled Bread
recipes.summary: Stretchy, flaky griddled breads served with curry sauce or sweetened condensed milk.
steps: Mix the flour, salt, egg, water and 1 tablespoon of oil to a soft dough, knead for 5 minutes and rest for 1 hour.
Divide into 6 balls and soak in the remaining oil for 20 minutes.
Stretch each ball by hand over an oiled surface until paper thin.
Fold into a square and fry on a hot oiled pan for 3 minutes each side, until golden and crisp.
Drizzle with condensed milk or serve with curry.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Food safety: cook until the egg in the dough is fully set; the bread should be golden throughout.

recipes.title: Gazpacho Verde Green Cucumber and Herb Gazpacho
recipes.summary: A cold green soup of cucumber, capsicum, herbs and a little bread, brighter and fresher than the red version.
steps: Blend all the ingredients until completely smooth.
Strain if you prefer a finer soup.
Taste and adjust the salt and vinegar.
Chill for 2 hours until very cold.
Serve in glasses or bowls with a drizzle of oil.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Keeps 2 days in the fridge; stir before serving.

recipes.title: Salmorejo Cordobes Thick Chilled Tomato Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, creamy tomato and bread soup from Cordoba, finished with chopped egg and olive oil.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, bread and garlic until a thick puree forms.
Add the oil in a slow stream with the blender running until pale and creamy.
Blend in the vinegar and salt.
Chill for 2 hours until cold.
Serve topped with the chopped egg and a drizzle of oil.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Food safety: boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm and keep the soup cold; eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Chlodnik Polish Cold Beetroot and Buttermilk Soup
recipes.summary: A hot pink chilled soup of beetroot, buttermilk, cucumber and dill, served with a halved boiled egg.
steps: Simmer the beetroot in the water for 15 minutes, until tender, then cool completely.
Stir in the buttermilk, lemon juice and salt.
Fold through the cucumber, radish, dill and spring onion.
Chill for 2 hours until very cold.
Serve topped with halves of boiled egg.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Food safety: boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm and keep the soup cold; eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Korean Oi Naengguk Chilled Cucumber Soup
recipes.summary: A sour, savoury cold soup of cucumber in vinegar broth, refreshing beside spicy food and hot rice.

items: 3 Lebanese cucumbers, cut in thin strips

steps: Stir the water, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, salt and garlic until the sugar dissolves.
Add the cucumber and spring onion.
Chill for 30 minutes until very cold.
Taste and adjust with extra vinegar or sugar.
Serve in bowls with the sesame oil and seeds.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Add a few ice cubes to serve. Keep cold and eat within a day.

recipes.title: Hiyashi Chuka Cold Ramen Salad
recipes.summary: Cold noodles under rows of egg, cucumber, tomato and ham with a sweet-sour soy dressing, a Japanese summer lunch.

items: 2 Lebanese cucumbers, cut in thin strips
100g sliced cooked ham, cut in strips

steps: Whisk the eggs and cook in a thin layer in the oiled pan for 1 minute each side, until fully set, then cut in strips.
Boil the noodles for 3 minutes, drain, rinse under cold water until cold and drain well.
Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and water until the sugar dissolves.
Divide the noodles between 4 plates.
Arrange the egg, cucumber, tomato and ham on top and pour over the dressing.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until completely set and keep the ham refrigerated until serving. Eat within a few hours of making.

recipes.title: Chilled Avocado and Lime Soup
recipes.summary: A silky no-cook soup of avocado, cucumber and lime, finished with coriander and chilli.
steps: Blend the avocado, cucumber, stock, yoghurt, lime juice, coriander and chilli until completely smooth.
Season with the salt and blend again briefly.
Chill for 1 hour until very cold.
Taste and add more lime if needed.
Serve in chilled bowls with extra coriander.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Avocado browns quickly, so serve within a day.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime and Mint Soup
recipes.summary: A lightly sweet chilled watermelon soup with lime, mint and a little chilli.
steps: Blend the rockmelon, lime juice, half the mint, yoghurt and honey until completely smooth.
Season with the salt and blend again briefly.
Chill for 1 hour until very cold.
Taste and adjust the lime.
Serve garnished with the remaining mint and the chilli.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Serve within a day.

recipes.title: Chilled Sweet Corn Soup with Lime
recipes.summary: A sweet, creamy cold corn soup with a little heat, served with lime and coriander.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the corn, chilli and stock and simmer for 10 minutes, until the corn is tender.
Blend until completely smooth and strain for a silky texture.
Stir in the lime juice and salt, then chill for 2 hours until cold.
Serve topped with chopped coriander.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Vichyssoise Classic Chilled Leek and Potato Soup
recipes.summary: Velvety cold leek and potato soup with cream, the French summer classic with chives.
steps: Melt the butter and cook the leek for 8 minutes, until soft but not coloured.
Add the potato and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the potato is very soft.
Blend until completely smooth and stir in the cream and salt.
Chill for 3 hours until cold.
Serve cold, scattered with chives.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Contains dairy. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Chilled Tomato and Watermelon Soup
recipes.summary: Ripe tomato and sweet watermelon blended with basil and a splash of vinegar, perfect for hot days.
steps: Blend the tomato, watermelon, half the basil, garlic and vinegar until smooth.
Blend in the oil and salt.
Strain for a smooth texture if you prefer.
Chill for 2 hours until icy cold.
Serve with torn basil and a drizzle of oil.
notes: Chilling time is not included in prep. Serve within a day.

recipes.title: Warm Bulgur Salad with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.summary: Chewy farro with roasted zucchini, capsicum and red onion, finished with balsamic and parsley while still warm.
steps: Cook the bulgur in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender but chewy, then drain.
Roast the zucchini, capsicum and onion with 1 tablespoon of oil at 220C for 25 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Whisk the remaining oil, balsamic and salt.
Toss the warm bulgur with the roast vegetables and dressing until evenly coated.
Top with parsley and the vegetarian hard cheese.
notes: Vegetarian hard cheese is used so it suits vegetarians. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Warm Chickpea and Spinach Salad with Cumin
recipes.summary: Chickpeas sizzled with cumin and garlic, tossed through spinach with lemon and yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chickpeas and cumin and cook for 6 minutes, until golden and lightly crisp.
Remove from the heat and stir through the spinach until just wilted.
Add the lemon juice and salt.
Serve warm with the yoghurt spooned over.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge, but is best eaten warm.

recipes.title: Warm Barley and Mushroom Salad
recipes.summary: Nutty pearl barley with golden mushrooms, thyme and mustard dressing, a warm salad for cool days.
steps: Boil the barley for 30 minutes, until tender with a little chew, then drain.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tablespoon of oil over high heat for 6 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic and thyme leaves for 1 minute.
Whisk the remaining oil, mustard, vinegar and salt.
Toss the warm barley, mushrooms, dressing and parsley together.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Warm Cannellini and Kale Salad
recipes.summary: White beans and cavolo nero wilted in garlicky oil with lemon, a Tuscan-style warm salad.

items: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 bunch cavolo nero, stems removed and leaves shredded

steps: Heat the oil and cook the garlic and chilli for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cavolo nero and cook for 5 minutes, until wilted and tender.
Add the beans and warm through for 3 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and salt.
Serve warm with crusty bread.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Warm Brown Rice and Edamame Salad
recipes.summary: Nutty brown rice with edamame, carrot and spring onion in a ginger-soy dressing.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 25 minutes, until tender, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes.
Drain well and return the rice to the pot.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss the warm rice and edamame with the carrot, spring onion and dressing.
Scatter with sesame seeds.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Contains soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Warm Israeli Couscous Salad with Herbs and Almonds
recipes.summary: Pearl couscous toasted and tossed with herbs, lemon, currants and almonds.
steps: Toast the couscous in 1 tablespoon of oil for 3 minutes, until golden.
Add the boiling water, cover and cook for 8 minutes, until the water is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and cool for 5 minutes.
Stir in the oil, lemon juice, herbs, currants, almonds and salt.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
notes: Contains gluten and tree nuts. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
